topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text:
Well now, I reckoned someone in this village might be feeling a mite curious or maybe even flustered, receiving flowers with no words to tell who sent 'em. Me, I've always had a way with the earth and her blooms, coaxing colors and fragrances from the soil that's seen better days. It's a skill not lost on me, nor the folks around here, I fancy. 

Someone's got a secret admirer, that's for sure, and I can only hope the mystery brings a smile as bright as the day they found those blossoms. No matter thecomplexContent, a bit of beauty in a common basket can brighten the darkest of days. I've seen it myself, tending the fields, watching the way the sun warms the cold, hard ground, giving life to the simplest of seeds. Perhaps whoever finds those flowers finds a bit of that warmth, too.
